An '''ion stunner pistol''', also known as an '''ion flare gun''', was a small weapon, identifiable by a focusing dish on its barrel. When operated, it would fire a short ion flash capable of temporarily disrupting electronic devices. This made it particularly adept at disabling [[Blast door/Legends|security doors]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==History==
It was often used by thugs in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]]. During robberies, thugs could also use the ion stunner on organic beings to disorient them. The stunner is also popular with the "street smart" on the under-levels of Republic Capital. It was also used on the ''[[Avatar Orbital Platform]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
